definitions.explanation: Furniture or equipment that is fixed in place or supplied as part of a room, building, or vehicle, rather than brought by the user.

examples.japanese: {備|そな}え{付|つ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧。
examples.english: Furniture that comes with the place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{備|そな}え{付|つ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The room has a refrigerator provided.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{備|そな}え{付|つ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドライヤー→ドライヤー：05076_doraiyaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れていた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦フロント→フロント：01378_furonto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}した→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: The hotel room's hair dryer was broken, so I called the front desk.

notes:
From {備|そな}え{付|つ}ける (to install, to equip): ⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧ (to provide) + ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach). Also written {備|そな}え{付|つ}け or {備付|そなえつけ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {備|そな}え{付|つ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: furniture provided
- {備|そな}え{付|つ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: a built-in shelf
- ⟦{各部屋|かくへや}→各部屋：27608_kakuheya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{備|そな}え{付|つ}け: provided in every room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with ~ included (⟦{家具付|かぐつ}き→家具付き：20223_kagutsuki⟧, furnished), the everyday word in rental listings
- {作|つく}り{付|つ}け: built into the structure (a built-in wardrobe)
